title: Hostel Code of Conduct & Maintenance Regulations 2024
content: Maintenance requests for electrical and air cooling issues must be inspected by the maintenance supervisor within 24 hours of ticket submission. If replacement of parts is required, the resolution window is 48 hours. Emergency issues involving water leakage near electrical fixtures must be treated as priority hazard cases and attended within 4 hours.

title: University Fee Payment & Refund Policy 2024-25
content: In cases where a student's bank account is debited multiple times for a single semester fee installment due to payment gateway timeout, the excess amount is reconciled within 3 working days with the payment aggregator. Refunds for confirmed duplicate debits are credited back to the source bank account within 7 to 10 working days upon submission of the bank debit advice.

title: Continuous Assessment & Grade Evaluation By-Laws
content: A student identifying an inconsistency between evaluated continuous assessment (CA) marks and the marks uploaded on the Grade Management System may register a grievance within 7 days of grade publication. The course instructor and Head of Department must verify the physical or digital evaluation rubric and rectify any clerical data-entry error within 5 working days.

title: Examination Conduct & Hall Ticket Release Rules
clause: Regulation 12.1 (Hall Ticket / Admit Card Clearance Hold)
content: Admit cards are generated 7 days prior to the commencement of End Term Examinations. In the event of an erroneous administrative hold (e.g. library or laboratory clearance), the student may present an official return counter receipt. The Examination Branch is authorized to execute an emergency temporary clearance override within 4 hours to guarantee the student's right to appear in the scheduled examination.

title: Student Attendance & Medical Leave Regulations
content: Students with severe illness or hospitalization may apply for medical leave duty adjustment. The application must be supported by a certified discharge summary from a registered medical practitioner and endorsed by the University Health Center. If approved, attendance credit of up to a maximum of 10% (adjusting threshold to 65%) will be granted.

title: Government & External Scholarship Verification Guidelines
content: Institutional verification for state and national scholarship schemes (including NSP and PMS) must be completed by the designated Nodal Officer at least 5 days before the statutory portal closing date. Students must ensure their Aadhaar linkage and enrolled status are verified in the central registry prior to final portal submission.

title: Campus IT Infrastructure & Wi-Fi Access Policy
clause: Clause 2.4 (Device Quota and MAC Address Re-binding)
content: Each registered student is allotted two active device MAC registrations on the campus secure wireless network. When an existing device is deleted, RADIUS synchronization takes up to 60 minutes to flush stale leases. In case of persistent allocation lockouts, IT helpdesk personnel can execute a manual RADIUS session reset.

title: Official Student Certificate & Academic Document Issuance SOP
content: Bonafide Student Certificates and English Medium of Instruction (MOI) verification letters for official purposes (such as visa, passport, or exchange programs) are issued as digitally signed e-certificates within 3 working days through the student portal, provided all semester fee dues are cleared.
